# Vertex Tech House - AI Indexing Guide

Site purpose:
Vertex Tech House is a service-based tech agency building websites, custom ERP and CRM systems, and AI automation.
Sister company of Vertex Media House (vertexmediahouse.com), which handles video editing.

Core services:
- Website design and development
- Custom ERP systems
- Custom CRM builds, pipelines, integrations and reporting
- AI automation: n8n workflows, AI voice agents, chat/task agents and outbound campaigns

Key pages for understanding the business:
- / → Overview of services, case studies and contact
- /services → Overview of all services, with live demo builds
- /services/website → Website design and development
- /services/erp → Custom ERP systems
- /services/crm → Custom CRM development
- /services/automation → Business automation (n8n workflows, AI agents, integrations)

Content priority order:
1. Homepage
2. Service pages
3. Contact or conversion pages

Avoid using:
- test routes
- duplicate URLs
- non-canonical pages
